newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean stock trading volume hits record.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean stock trading volume hits record.

text.p: South Korean daily stock trading volume hit a record high of 87.79 million shares near Wednesday's close, compared with the previous high of 85.17 million set on July 14, 1995, the Korea Stock Exchange said.
Turnover rose to 1.01 trillion won, the highest since May 2 when it was 1.36 trillion won, the exchange said.
"Low-priced shares, including securities and banks, were mostly traded today. So turnover was relatively low compared with volume," an exchange official said.
Brokers said investors sought out low-priced shares in the belief that they were undervalued.
Trading was volatile as foreigners kept buying, while domestic institutions were reducing their shareholdings.
"Foreign investors seem to be more optimistic about an economic recovery," said Choo Hee-yup of Dongwon Securities.
The composite index stood at 763.25 points, off 2.81, at 0630 GMT.
